sentence: a ball-and-paddle game in a walled court
title: Paddle Court

brief.rules: Two paddles, one ball. A ball passing a paddle scores for the other side. First to 5 wins.
brief.arena: A flat court 16 m by 9 m with walls on the long sides and open goal lines on the short sides.
brief.ai: The opponent paddle follows the ball with a reaction delay and a speed cap.
brief.controls: paddle_up and paddle_down move the player's paddle along the goal line.
brief.mood: Flat-shaded blocks, two team colours, soft top light.

packages.title: Entry script and rally bot
packages.contract:
The manifest is composed by the Foreman: entry scripts/main.gd, tests [tests/bot_rally.gd], one camera view (hero).
scripts/main.gd: _pack_setup(ctx), _pack_start(), _pack_tick(frame), _pack_state() -> {score: {left: int, right: int}, rally: int}.
Input actions: paddle_up, paddle_down. tests/bot_rally.gd: holds the ball in play for 300 frames.

packages.title: Walled court layout
packages.contract:
data/court.json: {width_m: 16, depth_m: 9, wall_height_m: 1.2, walls: [north, south], goals: [west, east]}.
scripts/court.gd: static func build(ctx, layout: Dictionary) -> void; builds walls under ctx.root from kit parts.

packages.title: Opponent paddle
packages.contract:
data/ai.json: {reaction_frames: 8, max_speed_mps: 6.0, error_m: 0.3}.
scripts/paddle_ai.gd: func decide(ball_y: float, paddle_y: float, tuning: Dictionary) -> float (axis in -1..1).
